description: **Inbox of pending approvals across conversations** (dsh_status covers a single one). Lists every approval waiting for your decision: conversation id and title, approval id, tool, reason, a summary of the command or path, and how long it has waited. Decide with dsh_approval_decide. Returns an empty list when nothing is pending.

include_input.description: Whether to include a summary of the operation's input (default true).

name: dsh_inbox
title: Approval inbox
